scope.flow: PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance() reads HyperCore PM supplied balance and Monetrix backing/surplus calculation
scope.environment: Hyperliquid HyperEVM with Portfolio Margin and delayed CoreWriter order execution

statements.text: Under Portfolio Margin, an account placing spot or perp orders with insufficient idle balance can automatically borrow against eligible collateral, creating a borrow liability that accrues interest and must be repaid.
CoreWriter order actions and vault transfers are delayed onchain for a few seconds, so during the delay the actual HyperCore execution state can differ from the EVM side estimate.
A hedge via executeHedge() that looked fully funded when orders were enqueued can later execute with a PM borrow on HyperCore.
suppliedBalance() calls PRECOMPILE_SUPPLIED_BALANCE to read the account's PM supplied balance state.
When backing is calculated, suppliedUsdcEvm() and suppliedNotionalUsdcFromPerp() both rely on suppliedBalance().
Settlement yield is calculated from totalBackingSigned() and surplus() when PM automatically creates a borrow.

suppliedBalance() assigns only supply.value to supplied and discards borrow.value, returning a gross supplied amount instead of signed net borrow/lend state, so the borrow liability is not deducted from backing.
Because only the supply side is added and the borrow side is not deducted, PM borrow can make reported backing higher than the account's net assets.
Yield can be distributed that is not backed by net assets when settlement is calculated from overstated totalBackingSigned() and surplus().
This causes direct loss to protocol backing and can leave insufficient assets to cover future redemptions.
Backing and surplus used for yield settlement should reflect the account's net assets, deducting PM borrow liabilities from supplied balances.
A PM borrow is a liability that must reduce net backing.

ambiguities: Report does not establish that a PM borrow actually occurred in a real transaction; the borrow scenario is described as possible (can/may).
No explicit statement that anyone can call suppliedBalance() or trigger the borrow; caller/authorization is unspecified.
The exact numeric overstatement of totalBackingSigned() or surplus() is not given.
Whether USDC is registered as a supplied slot (affecting _readL1Backing() coverage) is not stated.
